reader.requirement: In a format 1 SEARCH VARYING, the compiler must use index-name-1 as the search index when it is an index-name of identifier-1, else the first index-name of identifier-1; and must increment in step a VARYING index-name of another table by one occurrence (GR8a), a VARYING index data item by the same amount as the search index, and a VARYING integer data item by one (GR8b), leaving the table's other index-names unchanged; SR2's operand class and first-index-subscript ban are the refusal half.

edition-consulted.switches: nothing: the EditionContext is the diagnostic sink only

reader.edition-search: Read BindSearch's VARYING arm (same-table index, other-table index SetIndexTarget, data item SetPlaceTarget) and EmitSerialScan's in-step AugmentSetTarget(+1); grepped both files for Edition/DialectBehavior/CobolVersion.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf15_07 and the l1 witnesses cover a successful search with each VARYING operand class; not exercised: an AT END search with VARYING another table's index, a table of different element size, an index data item set from another table's index, signed/COMP/negative identifier-2, a subscripted identifier-2, PIC 9 wrap, an ODO table, and the SR2 refusals

probes.printed: P2 IA=05 IB=01 IC=03; P3 IA=03 JX=06 JY=09; P4 AT END IA=06 JX=04; P5 IA=04 XD-AS-JX=08; P6 IA=05 NC=+0001; P6B IA=04 NS=+00; P7 NE=102230; P7B N9=1; P8 AT END OX=05 OY=04
probes.expected: VARYING IC is the search index, IA IB unchanged; JX advances with IA occurrence for occurrence (GR8a), JY unchanged; XD advances by the same amount (GR8b); integer items +1 per increment (-3+4=1, -2+2=0, 20+2=22, 8+3 truncated to 1)

probes.printed: COBOL2325 for VARYING PIC 9V9 and PIC X(2); COBOL2325 for VARYING NE (IA) subscripted by the first index-name; COBOL2075/COBOL0900 for subscripted identifier-1

reader.notes: Indexes are occurrence numbers in this implementation, so the in-step +1 of another table's index or an index data item is the same amount as the search index's increment. Diagnostics at --std 85 cite §2023 clause numbers (cosmetic, not this rule). The PIC 9 wrap (8 -> 1 after three increments) follows the truncating arithmetic the text leaves unstated.
